estimate: About 200 hours, one playthrough, difficulty 4/10 (PowerPyx). No online trophies, no difficulty setting, no mission medals, no mission replay — long, not hard.
missableNote: Only one trophy is reported as potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude, because of Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation. Every other trophy — story included — stays available after the credits, since there is free-roam after the story and all trophy-related quest givers return. Sources: PowerPyx (GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap) and GTABase, both 18 Nov 2026.
saveAdvice: The game has 15 manual save slots and no mission replay. Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (10 saves), then rotate the last 5 for free-roam cleanup. Never turn cheats on during a trophy run: cheats switch trophies and saving off.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

stages.name: Play the story
steps: Play the main missions (pink icons with black letters). Side content can wait.

Chapter 1 — do the one thing that can be missed: after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose 'Accept' to meditate. It is the only missable moment in the whole list (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Chapter 2 — 'Coffee Break' unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia and calling your partner. From here, partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) open up.
Chapter 3 — 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' unlocks the Snap Gun and jewellery robberies; 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs' unlocks the Key Cloner. Both feed later trophies.
Chapter 4 — the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' opens bank vault robberies. Do it when it appears.
Save at the start and end of each chapter. Before the final mission, save in a spare slot.
stages.summary: Chapters 1 to 5, in order. Every story trophy pops as you finish chapters and named missions — 12 chapter and mission trophies, plus the final-mission gold.

stages.name: The 100% checklist
steps: Any 100 optional missions (there are 200+, purple icons and black icons with pink letters).
Any 70 of 80 challenges — you only need 50 for One Last Thing, so this trophy pops on the way.
Scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app; study any 100 of 255 animals with binoculars.
300 stunts (250 for Cunning Stunts), gold in all 42 shooting range challenges, drone races at all 14 locations.
3 collectible card sets of 18; WAiNK scans at 100 locations; meditate at 18 spots (15 for the checklist).
Full completion only for robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
stages.summary: After the credits, Progress > Stats > 100% Completion appears. Everything you did during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is closer to 60% of true completion, not a real 100%.

stages.name: Strangers and side finales
steps: Andy (Lucia-only, Chapter 3), Kenton (treasure diving, 7 shipwrecks), Billy (Thrillbilly Mudclub), Randy (16 sports cars), Tyrone (Jason-only, synthetic labs), Bret (Jason-only, hunting).
Strangers & Freaks: 8 strands that count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count.
Personal Best: max strength with both characters at once — train together so both progress.
Let's Go Bowling: all 3 valuables at Kingpin Bowling; the robbery icon respawns if you miss one.
stages.summary: The side-character finales and the 8 stranger strands. None of them are needed for 100%, so they are often still open after stage 2 — and all of them stay available in free-roam.

stages.name: Crime, money and one-offs
steps: Rob 5 bank vaults (8 for 100%), one illegal operation per gang (all 39 for 100%), an armoured truck.
Launder $250,000 in marked bills (Dye Pack Jammer from Chapter 3's 'Credit Check'), spend $100,000 in shops.
Buy all 8 garages ($160,000 total), register 10 vehicles with the Scooter Bros app.
One-offs: steal the VCIA plane, steal a Rhino tank, rob a jewellery store undetected, smash the blue Banshee out of the showroom.
Actions Speak Louder: 500 criminal-profile actions — it builds passively; avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile.
Four trophies are still unconfirmed by every guide (In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) — this guide says so plainly instead of inventing a method.
stages.summary: The robbery set and the money trophies, plus the one-off stunts. Most of these pop while you work on the 100% checklist; the rest are quick jobs you can do any time after the story.

stages.hours: The moment the rest is done
stages.name: Platinum
steps: Tick the last trophy off in the tracker below and the platinum is yours.
Export your progress from the tracker as a keepsake — the file is a plain list of the trophies you earned.
stages.summary: Vice Got a Price! pops the moment the other 54 are earned. There is nothing extra to do — the roadmap is the platinum.
